description: A shell script for upgrading a Kubernetes cluster on GCE from routes to IP aliases, including detection, configuration, and cleanup steps.

methods.name: get-k8s-node-routes-count
methods.description: Counts the number of k8s-node-route routes in GCP.

methods.name: detect-k8s-subnetwork
methods.description: Detects the subnetwork where the Kubernetes cluster resides.

methods.name: set-allow-subnet-cidr-routes-overlap
methods.description: Sets the allowSubnetCidrRoutesOverlap property for the subnetwork.

methods.name: add-k8s-subnet-secondary-ranges
methods.description: Adds secondary IP ranges for pods and services to the subnet.

methods.name: delete-k8s-node-routes
methods.description: Deletes all k8s node routes in GCP.
